rule.name: ForwardingMethodAlias
rule.message: This method only passes its parameters, in order, to another method of the same class. Call that method directly and delete the alias. Overrides, annotated methods (a deprecated alias) and factories named of or from are allowed.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[parent::*[self::ClassBody or self::EnumBody or self::RecordBody]/parent::*[self::ClassDeclaration[not(@Interface = true())] or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration]] [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('static', 'abstract', 'synchronized', 'native', 'strictfp'))] [not(ModifierList/Annotation)][not(FormalParameters/FormalParameter/ModifierList/Annotation)][not(TypeParameters)] [not(@Name = ('of', 'from'))][not(@Overridden = true())] [FormalParameters/@Size > 0] [let $method := ., $parameters := FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name, $call := Block[count(*) = 1]/(ReturnStatement | ExpressionStatement[$method/VoidType])/MethodCall, $type := function($t) { string-join(($t/descendant-or-self::*/(@SimpleName | @Kind | @ArrayDepth)) ! string(.), '|') }, $key := function($m) { string-join((for $t in $m/FormalParameters/FormalParameter/(ClassType | PrimitiveType | ArrayType) return $type($t), for $v in $m/FormalParameters/FormalParameter[@Varargs = true()] return 'varargs', for $r in $m/(ClassType | PrimitiveType | ArrayType | VoidType) return local-name($r) || $type($r), for $e in $m/ThrowsList/* return $e/@SimpleName), ',') }, $targets := ../MethodDeclaration[@Name = $call/@MethodName][not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('static', 'abstract'))], $wider := exists($method[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public']) and exists($targets[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'public')]) or exists($method[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'protected']) and exists($targets[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('public', 'protected'))]) or exists($method[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = ('public', 'protected', 'private'))]) and exists($targets[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private']) return exists($call) and not($wider) and not($call/TypeArguments) and ($call/*[1][self::ArgumentList] or $call/*[1][self::ThisExpression][not(*)]) and $call/@MethodName != $method/@Name and $call/ArgumentList/@Size = count($parameters) and (every $i in 1 to count($parameters) satisfies $call/ArgumentList/*[$i][self::VariableAccess]/@Name = $parameters[$i]) and count(../MethodDeclaration[@Name = $call/@MethodName]) = 1 and count(../MethodDeclaration[@Name = $method/@Name]) = 1 and exists($targets[not(TypeParameters)][$key(.) = $key($method)])]
